svg.title: Five-gene expression in lesions and matched uterine tissue

cc:Work.dc:title: Five-gene expression in lesions and matched uterine tissue
cc:Work.dc:description: Descriptive aggregate gene rank shifts in three external paired cohorts. Cell color encodes lesion minus uterine difference in percentile points.
